_observations_cross_register_note: Contradictions between exported tabs, or between a tab and the Drive source map, that no single-row rule of tools/registers_check.py can see. Each record quotes the cells, inventory rows and path-change rows it rests on under 'bindings', and the checker re-verifies every binding on every run (a drifted binding is a NEW problem), so an observation can never outlive its evidence.
